title: My goal for this newsletter
subtitle: Start here
html:
Quick guide for the newbies

My name is Joshua.

This is my newsletter blog - a place for me to be real and share my thoughts with you. I mostly write about technology, philosophy, and human nature - but more than likely I’ll deviate from those to explore many ideas.

My goal is to help you see the world in different ways. To help you be more creative, more curious. A random idea could lead you to starting a business, jumping into a different career, seeking more genuine relationships, and/or pursuing art.

Some posts are short, some are long. I hope to inspire new ideas that help you rethink and/or reshape your life for the better.

Little background on me:

  • I grew up out in the country in Oregon and I love the outdoors - I have a desire to analyze my life philosophically and nature helps with that

  • Endlessly curious - I love traveling the world to explore cultures and the people that make them up

  • Other parts of me desire to make an impact in this world, mostly with technology (I’ve been in startups the last decade - I co-founded Swell and I’m involved in many projects like Daily Build)

Now I’m building out content across Substack, Twitter, LinkedIn, and more…

Some of my favorite posts

  • Haiku from Claude

  • Joshua Tree notes, & the end of Nomad Year

  • Japanese mini trucks

  • How and why I fast

  • Values-fit

“Buy-me-a-coffee”

Inspired by kyla’s newsletter, I want to keep my work free and accessible - and one way to do that is to do a “buy-me-a-coffee” premium member model for $8/month.

Rather than have sponsorships, ads, and paywalled content, your monthly contribution will ensure that I can keep these posts free forever.
